data.body: AC amendment (gap finding 2): Specify interaction with 'user says proceed' early-exit. The new termination condition requires BOTH empty gap list AND user confirmation. The existing 'proceed' shortcut is a user-initiated override that should be treated as: (a) user-initiated early termination is preserved — if the user says 'proceed', they are confirming acceptance of the current Understanding Summary with any remaining gaps deferred. This satisfies condition (b) as a special user-override form. SKILL.md amendment must explicitly state whether 'proceed' bypasses the empty-gap-list check (it does — proceed is a user override, not system-imposed termination). Add to AC: grep -qiE 'proceed.*skip|say.*proceed|proceed.*move' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md (verifies 'proceed' shortcut is preserved in SKILL.md text).
